title: The Comet's Tail
subtitle: one task of two is optional
description: The tail is dust and theory. The dust is `optional: true` -- a task
that does not have to be done for the quest to complete -- and the
theory is the checkmark that is not. A quest whose tasks are ALL
optional completes on any one of them, because a quest where
nothing at all is required would complete itself the instant it
unlocked; with one required task, the optional one is exactly what
